The harness behind the character

Quick feedback. Room for a little judgment.

Immediate reactions come from code. A System One Model chooses what fits the moment. One shared event log keeps both paths in context. See how Jev answers several questions in one call.

01

Rules react immediately.

Taps, task changes and attention signals can trigger feedback as soon as the event arrives.

02

The model chooses.

Personality, recent events and an allowed action roster guide Jev’s next decision.

03

Both paths leave a trace.

Code and model outcomes append to the same log, which feeds the next iteration.

Why Mellow Machines?

Make room for something warm.

Mellow Machines Lab is a small open-source team applying frontier harness principles to build warm, welcoming, playful companions.

We feel the noise and anxiety around AI too. This is our after-work space to make something fun and heartwarming—and share the tools that help other builders do the same.
